svg.title: Entitlements architecture layers
svg.desc: BSS owns commercial decisions. Entitlements applies frozen terms through selected adapters, tracks results and reports readiness. OSS and providers execute and enforce. Optional hooks run through hook plugins with limited authority.

text.tspan: Apply purchased rights. Track delivery. Confirm readiness.
Quota limits, grants and service intent
Notices after a saved state change
Intake / manifests / desired sets / bindings / receipts / findings / hook journals / outbox
Readiness via Event Broker; full results via SDK reads
BSS defines purchased rights. Adapters own provider APIs. OSS owns allocation and usage.
